2.16.26
Textbox.Value
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Textbox.Value element specifies a value or an expression that is displayed for a Textbox.
Following is the parent element of the Textbox.Value element.
Parent elements
Textbox
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Textbox.Value element.
 <xsd:element name="Value" type="xsd:string" />
